detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Once a respected baron, you lost everything when a trusted vassal betrayed your family and seized your title. Forced to flee across the sea with only a handful of coins, you take refuge in a remote land and purchase a rundown stable to begin a new life.

Trade horses, formulate feed, and breed generations of elite horses. Train and auction valuable stock, expand your stables, mine resources, forge weapons and armor, farm crops, run merchant caravans, recruit villagers, train mercenaries, and earn the favor of powerful lords. Build your fortune from the ground up and dominate the medieval horse trade.

When your forces are finally strong enough, return across the sea to confront the usurper, reclaim your birthright, and restore your family's honor.

1. Craft the Perfect Feed for Your Horses

Cut grass, plant crops on your farmland, and discover or invent advanced horse feed recipes to craft the perfect feed for your horses.

2. Care for Your Horses

Feed your horses and perform daily tasks to keep them comfortable, healthy, and in top condition.

3. Train Your Horses

Use a variety of training approaches to improve different aspects of your horses and make them stand out in the market.

4. Breed Elite Bloodlines

Breed foals across generations to improve growth and inherit powerful, positive traits. Discover, inherit, and combine epic horse bloodlines.

5. Establish Your Own Merchant Caravan

Prepare wagons, hire merchants, and equip them with horses to open trade routes between towns and earn high profits.

6. Run Your Own Blacksmith Shop

Mine ores, build your own blacksmith shop, upgrade equipment, uncover legendary blueprints, and craft high-quality items for your horses and mercenaries, or sell them to customers.

7. Build Your Own Mercenary Army

Hire villagers and train them into different troop types. Prepare weapons, armor, and horses, develop them from rookies into elite veterans, and accept contracts from nearby rulers and other clients.

8. Raise Livestock

Raise livestock, build shelters, and collect products such as milk and eggs. Care for newborn animals and sell livestock to local farmers.

9. Craft Valuable Goods

Produce cheese, brew beer, and craft other valuable goods to expand your business.
